thermals.title: Kobarid, Slovenia, 27 Aug 2023 — a plume rooted on the slope
thermals.note: 34 pilots in one thermal from 520 to 1150 m. The column hardly moves, but the wind lays it over at about 45°: the lower pilots circle upwind of the higher ones. Extended downwards, the axis meets the slope where the thermal leaves the ground.

thermals.title: Aksaray, Turkey, 18 Aug 2025 — strong wind over a plateau
thermals.note: 40 pilots from 2250 to 3280 m, 5 m/s of wind, about 480 m above the ground. The in-between case: the column both leans (half a metre per metre) and drifts (half the wind speed).

thermals.title: Niš, Serbia, 4 Aug 2022 — a column the wind carries away
thermals.note: 82 pilots from 1170 to 2180 m, 1600 m above the plain. The lean is small; instead the whole stack of the gaggle slides downwind at 0.8 of the wind — almost 3 m/s.
